allowlist_canonical: sha256 of json.dumps({'body','pending','wrapper','control_only'} sorted lists, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=True)

comms.geometry: one work-group of W = 2..8 wave32 waves per analysed work-group; a grid of 1..64 work-groups (the fuzzer uses 1..16), every work-group (k, 0, 0) analysed with its id in TTMP9
comms.transfers: ds_store/ds_load and global_store/global_load b32/b64/b128 between waves; a producer waits for completion (s_wait_dscnt 0 / s_wait_storecnt 0) before its barrier signal, a consumer loads after the barrier wait and waits (s_wait_dscnt 0 / s_wait_loadcnt 0) before using the data
comms.synchronisation: the work-group barrier (-1, every wave) or named barriers 1..2 (s_barrier_init with M0 member count before the start barrier, s_barrier_join once per wave, signal and wait)
comms.visibility: inside the selected work-group a global store whose completion was waited for before a barrier signal is visible to a load after the matching barrier wait at any scope
comms.grid: work-groups never read or write each other's slices; composition only when isolated (check workgroup_isolation); a cross-work-group read stays UNKNOWN
comms.lds: the request declares the static LDS allocation (lds_bytes) the descriptor declares; every LDS byte a wave reads was written earlier in the same launch

wrapper_forms: fuzzer comms experiment lines: m1 prologue; v_readfirstlane_b32 s20, v0; s_lshr_b32 s20, s20, 5; s_get_shader_cycles_u64 s[22:23]; s_getreg_b32 s21, hwreg(HW_REG_WAVE_HW_ID1); s_wait_kmcnt 0x0; lane addresses; [grid: s_mov_b32 s29, ttmp9; slice offset]; per-wave branch; per-wave section; s_get_shader_cycles_u64 s[26:27]; evidence store; s_endpgm
